unit: one record per stored observation examined, selected or not

enumerated_from.why: The frozen observation list, not the pages directory. The ingest fetched whole cursor pages and stopped at its waterfall target part-way through the last one, so the pages on disk carry rows the dataset never stored. Enumerating the pages put 23 of them into this denominator and into the published phrase 'the whole snapshot'. All 23 had no waterfall image, so no numerator moved when they left.

selection.pool_a: A3's rule verbatim: verdict_from_scores returns UNCORRECTED, which means sigma_curved - sigma_vertical >= SIGMA_MARGIN. Corridor-selected, published for comparability with the n = 3 result and not the gate.
selection.pool_b: No Doppler prediction anywhere in the rule: predicted swing >= 3000 Hz, trace_q75 >= 3.5 and sigma_vertical < 8.0. The swing is a property of the prediction rather than of the image, so it cannot be influenced by whether the corridor matches. This is the pre-registered pool.
selection.trace_q75: the 75th percentile of the per-row maximum robust z-score over the spectrogram interior. Under noise the maximum of W columns sits near sqrt(2 ln W), about 3.7 at these widths.
